Employees who lose eligibility (e.g., terminated, reduced hours below threshold, anything was found or no longer paying premiums).

Dependents who age out (usually at age 26, unless disabled).

Ex-spouses (after a divorce, unless COBRA or similar continuation coverage is elected).

Dependents who no longer qualify (e.g., not a full-time student if the plan requires it, or losing legal guardianship).
